description: DRAFT — shape taken from the reference composer's real output. An S2UI surface payload is a list of A2UI 1.0 messages. The snapshot form is a single createSurface message carrying the components and the full data model inline; bindings are {"@path": ...} references into that data model. Live surfaces may follow with updateComponents / updateDataModel / deleteSurface messages (spec §7). catalogId is the A2UI Basic Catalog URL until a Beth catalog file ships with a stable catalogId of its own (spec §5).
title: S2UI Surface Messages v1 — DRAFT
